newsitem.title: USA: Battery charge filed against Motley Crue drummer.
newsitem.headline: Battery charge filed against Motley Crue drummer.

text.p: Rock drummer Tommy Lee, the husband of "Baywatch" star Pamela Anderson Lee, was charged on Tuesday with battery following a recent incident with a photographer, the district attorney's office said.
A spokesman said one misdemeanor charge of battery with serious bodily injury had been filed. Authorites were attempting to contact his lawyer to arrange for the musician to be booked.
The incident occurred two weeks ago outside a trendy Hollywood club, the Viper Room, when photographer Henry Trappler tried to snap pictures of Lee and his wife.
The drummer with the rock band Motley Crue reportedly pushed Trappler who fell. He was treated in the hospital and later filed a battery complaint.
